name.value: Soggy Frog Guest Suite on Bowen

description.value: A self-contained guest suite located on Bowen Island, a small car-accessible island reachable by a short BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The property is listed on Airbnb as a standalone apartment-style unit in a residential house. Bowen Island is a popular day-trip and touring destination with quiet roads and scenic landscapes, making accommodation options here particularly valuable to cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
